messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to the one demonstrated in the motion reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action to the one demonstrated in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands in profile, then turns his head and upper body, raising his hands near his face before returning to a standing pose.","camera":"A static medium shot from the side, framing the subject from the thighs up.","clothing":"A white and gray plaid button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, tan suspenders, and dark pants.","hair_color":"Dark brown/black with vivid blue highlights and a blue ponytail.","hairstyle":"Short dark hair with a bright blue streak across the forehead and a tall blue ponytail.","identity":"A young man with a slim build, shown in profile and three-quarter views.","scene":"An outdoor paved area with a metal railing, green foliage, rocks, and a utility pole in the background under daylight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's large arm-raising motion with a more restrained sequence: the person stands in profile, turns the head and upper body, brings hands near the face/chest, and returns to a standing pose. The same character, blue ponytail, plaid shirt, suspenders, outdoor scene, and static side camera are retained.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's action with the movement from the motion reference while preserving identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Exact fidelity to the reference motion timing and pose sequence is difficult to confirm from the sampled frames.
unexpected_changes: The output motion is noticeably smaller and less closely aligned with the reference's head turn, hand-to-face, and arm-crossing sequence than the source's original motion was.
